locations.note: Adam Stoker spends the night at Ellen's apartment and leaves only a note, and her colleague Gerry is killed after finding Radu's poem.
Following Radu's poem 'The Shadow of the Dragon', Ellen finds the secret society's headquarters at the Basilica Cistern and learns that Adam Stoker, Radu's descendant, leads it.
Ellen returns to the painter Yanek, who reveals himself as the vampire Kaneyek, explains that only a vampire not born of Dracula can destroy him, and sends her to meet the Count.
In his underground castle in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, Dracula foils Adam's attack with the dagger and offers Ellen his dead wife's blood.
Back at the Met, Ellen strips the tar from the sixteenth Vambery painting to reveal Dracula's portrait, which Adam Stoker later steals from storage.

routes.name: Ellen Cross
routes.note: From the Met in New York to the secret society beneath Istanbul and on to Dracula's lair in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.
